outline: This course helps the learners recognize the syntax, style, and organization as far as the papers on English writings are concerned.
schedule:
01 02/22 Intro(research topic)
02 03/01 Endnote and Turnitin (bring your own laptop)
03 03/08 Research- Abstract
04 03/15 Research- Introduction
05 03/22 school sports day-No class
06 03/29 TVET Conference
07 04/05 No Class
08 04/12 Research- Literature Review & Introduction Practice
09 04/19 Midterm Week
10 04/26 Research- Method
11 05/03 Research Result & Discussion
12 05/10 Research Conclusion and Suggest
13 05/17 Research Conclusion and Suggest
14 05/24 Writing for Final Paper Preparation
15 05/31 Final Presentation 1(15 mins per student)
16 06/07 Final Presentation 2(15 mins per student)
17 06/14 Final Presentation 3(15 mins per student)
18 06/21 Final Exam Week (final paper due)
assessment:
Grading:
1. Attendance 15%
2. Abstract 20%
3. Final Presentation 25%
4. Final Research Paper 40%
- 12 font, 1.5 spaces
- suggest full paper (7 pages)
5. Additional grade 5% (papers are accepted in International journal or conference)
